title: Check the cut before delivery
summary: Check the active Video Project's timeline and optional rendered picture/sound measurements for unintended gaps, flashes, overlaps, long holds, out-of-range transitions, missing or short sources, title overflow, unexpected black or frozen spans, scene-change slivers, and off-target loudness. Reads only; never changes the Project.

carrier.notes: Reached by the agent through luc_invoke with capability_id video.cut.check; the Runtime runs the packaged tool check_cut. A standalone delivery-render wrapper helper also exists in lumeri_runtime/export_check.py:159-259, exercised in tests and not wired into delivery rendering.

replaceability.why: The package carries Python code the Runtime runs, so its own files stay as they shipped. A creator's layer may add a program that answers for a capability instead: it runs only in the code sandbox, reaches the Project only through ToolHost's calls over its pipe, and is held to this contract (docs/luc/tool-programs.md).
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 (2026-10-18): tool/v2 code is not replaceable this week; Acrab 2026-10-26: replaced by programs in the code sandbox

operations.name: check_cut

quality.description: The quality the cut was rendered at, for example draft or 1080p. The rules are the same at every quality.

analysis.description: What Lumeri measured in a rendered file: black, frozen picture, scene changes and loudness. Filled in by Lumeri after a render; leave it out to check the timeline only.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced on a packaged read; the tool reads the timeline and media list once. The shipped output_schema is the bare {type: object} (lumeri_runtime/luc_packaged_tools.py:556); this contract is the real one.

events.name: luc.module_fell_back
events.notes: Emitted once per Session in a start by luc_tool_program._notice (with layer {id, version} and no capability_id) when a layer's program breaks and the Official code answers instead; emitted once per turn_id by export_check._event (including capability_id and the entry's {id, version} identity mapping in layer) when the standalone export_check.wrap helper falls back to the unaugmented render receipt.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters of the rendered result the model sees; longer is cut with a note

bounds.name: quality_max_chars
bounds.unit: characters of the optional quality argument

bounds.name: self_check_max_findings
bounds.unit: findings accepted on a delivery-render self_check receipt

bounds.name: self_check_max_findings_bytes
bounds.unit: UTF-8 JSON bytes of findings accepted on a delivery-render self_check receipt

invariants.text: Calling check_cut never changes the Project: it authorizes only project.read and holds no edit scope.
Unknown arguments, a non-string or oversized quality, or a malformed analysis object are refused with arguments_invalid before reading the Project.
When lumeri.cut-check is switched off in [luc] config, video.cut.check is not offered to the agent.

break: A layer's program does not start, answers late, too large or out of shape, or ends.
It asks for a host call that does not exist, with other arguments, or more than 256 of them.
Its result does not keep the output schema, or its refusal names an error code not listed here.
failure.notes: The Official code answers the same call, and every call of this Luc for the rest of the start; the Session hears luc.module_fell_back once and luc_breaker counts one break.

conformance.notes: Tested as an agent tool via luc_invoke, with a replacement tool program in the sandbox (on and break), and with the standalone export_check.wrap helper in tests/test_runtime_export_check.py (not wired into delivery rendering).

known_deviations.text: Stopping the turn does not stop a program mid-call; the 10 s deadline per answer and the bound of 256 host calls end it.
